title: Mahaarti & Tomorrow's Announcement
writeup: Tonight's Sandhya Mahaarti brought the whole galli together once more, chants and diyas filling the mandap as we near the final days of this year's Ganeshotsav. During the gathering, tomorrow's schedule was announced — Shri's aarti at 4 PM, followed by murti pooja and the idol being taken up for the procession, with mantrakshata given to all devotees present. Prize distribution for this year's competitions will also take place. Mark your calendars — tomorrow is a big one. 🙏
